Most advice on this topic is vague. This guide is a field note: what to change on your site this week so you stand out for the right reasons.

undefined

This guide is for design-minded students who want taste without clutter who want a site that feels intentional — not another generic template dump.

The real problem

Restraint reads as confidence. Empty space and hierarchy often look more expensive than extra widgets.

Do this next

  1. One accent color, not five
  2. Let project images breathe
  3. Motion only where it clarifies

One composition, one job

Each section should do one thing: introduce you, prove a project, or invite contact. When sections compete, nothing lands.

How a website helps you stand out

Restraint reads as confidence. Empty space and hierarchy often look more expensive than extra widgets.

On BEXO, that path is simple: discover on mybexo.cyou, create on dash.mybexo.cyou, share on yourname.mybexo.cyou. Premium templates and a Hire Me page give you agency-grade presentation without becoming a full-time webmaster.

Field checklist

  • One accent color, not five
  • Let project images breathe
  • Motion only where it clarifies

Try this today

Open your draft (or start one), apply one change from the list above, and publish. Momentum compounds faster than waiting for “ready.”
